course.description:
NIRBHAY Batch – Class 12th Commerce (Boards 2026 + CUET)
The Most Fearless, Complete & Score-Boosting Crash Course for Class 12th Boards + CUET 2026 

 

  1. Complete syllabus of Accountancy,Economics,Business Studies,Applied Maths, English, Hindi , GK, Current Affairs, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Reasoning, Numerical Ability & Quantitative Aptitude for Class 12 Boards + CUET.
  2. Boards (Nirbhay) + CUET integrated teaching: Concepts, MCQs & PYQs explained together.
  3. PDF notes after every class for Boards + CUET.
  4. Regular chapter-wise tests + full syllabus mock tests.
  5. Live + Recorded classes of English, Hindi for CUET exam. 
  6. CUET General Test included: GK, Current Affairs, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Reasoning, Numerical Ability & Quantitative Aptitude (Live + Recorded Format).
  7. CUET Preparation will be in 2 Phases -
    Phase 1: Till Board Exams
    Phase 2: After Board Exam
  8. Only this batch will continue till your CUET final exam.
